name: Silver Street
desc1: This is a cobblestoned street. It is dimly lit by guttering lanterns
desc2: hung from tall posts. It is quiet and nearly deserted here, mostly due
desc3: to the fact that the city gates have been closed for some time as the
desc4: frequency of highway robbers has increased. There is an impenetrable-
desc5: looking stone structure to the north, with barred windows. Its large
desc6: door is iron-banded, and the sign nailed over it reads "Jail". The
desc7: street continues to the east and west.
